ssl_4000e.source: data/schematics/ssl_4000e/README.md: SSL's reissue of the 82E01 circuit, EIN < -130.6 dBu (A, 70 dB, 150R); here at its most gain, ~69.6 dB

api_312.source: data/schematics/api_312/README.md: API's 1972 Circuit Specifications, Fig. 1 (58 dB), equivalent input noise -129 dBm, 20-20 kHz unweighted

neumann_u87.source: data/schematics/neumann_u87/README.md: Neumann's 1970s catalog, self-noise ~26 dB (DIN 45 405, quasi-peak); sensitivity 7.7 mV/Pa as K87@2's fit reached

neumann_km84.source: data/schematics/neumann_km84/README.md: 17 dB-A (and 25 dB DIN 45 405); sensitivity 5 mV/Pa as KK84@1's fit reached

neumann_u47_fet.source: data/schematics/neumann_u47_fet/README.md: Neumann's brochure, 18 dB-A; sensitivity 8 mV/Pa as the circuit reached (CHAINS_PLAN.md WP25)

akg_c414.source: data/schematics/akg_c414/README.md: AKG's C414 B-ULS sheet, 14 dB-A; sensitivity 12.5 mV/Pa as fitted (WP23)

crown_pzm.source: data/schematics/crown_pzm/README.md: 20 dB(A); sensitivity 7 mV/Pa as fitted (WP26)
